Class ArenaServer

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.server.ArenaServer
public final class ArenaServer extends Object
Everything that happens on the integrated server while the agent trains: the arena, the sparring bot, episode resets and the bookkeeping of who hit whom.

The same arena also hosts sparring (startSpar(MinecraftServer, UUID, Config, SparPilot)): there the player plays their own character and the fake player is driven by the trained network instead of the scripted brain.

And it hosts training without the screen (startHeadless(MinecraftServer, UUID, Config, ArenaDriver)): there the agent's body is a second fake player, played from the server thread by an ArenaDriver, and the user's own character is left alone.

Every method except truth() must run on the server thread; the client reaches them through server.execute(...).

    • setOutside

      private void setOutside(String level)
      The outside bot: Carpet PvP's own fighter plays the arena's bot at this level ("beginner" to "expert"), with the kit the arena gives it, or with null no longer does and the scripted brain has it again. Set through its /bot option command, so nothing of Carpet PvP is needed to build this. Where the game has no such command the brain plays on.
